qualification_decision.reason: Identity and primary policy-wording lineage are governed and pinned by exact source hash. G11 must independently inventory waiting-period normative content before semantic mapping or publication.

g11_inventory_requirements: Use the authoritative policy wording source, not historical generated intelligence outputs.
Inventory must be high-recall and source-anchored before semantic mapping.
Search beyond standard-exclusion sections for optional covers, benefit-specific waivers, schedules/tables, portability/continuity, renewal effects and sum-insured enhancement behavior.
Every material normative unit must later be explicitly accounted as mapped, relationship-mapped, non-applicable, corroborating, deferred, conflicted or not-yet-representable.
No product-identity-bearing reasoning code may be introduced.
Residue is an expected success signal when the existing semantic model cannot represent a material mechanic.
